package.name: sentry_gazebo
package.description: RMUL 2027 sentry Gazebo Harmonic simulation: the arena (official STEP geometry as model://rmul_2027), the sentry robot built from sentry_description, MID-360 / Unitree L2 gpu_lidar sensors and the ROS 2 bridge. The TF chain and all state topics are stock (robot_state_publisher, gz OdometryPublisher / JointStatePublisher, ros_gz_bridge); the only custom code is the URDF->SDF generator, the planar velocity gz system and a small keyboard teleop node.
